stem:
The table shows the masses of four rocks.

Rocks

| Rock | Mass (kg) |
|------|-----------|
| S    | 0.429     |
| T    | 0.438     |
| U    | 0.43      |
| V    | 0.483     |

Which number sentence correctly compares the masses of two of the rocks?
visual_elements: Table showing rock names S, T, U, V and their masses in kilograms: 0.429, 0.438, 0.43, 0.483
